content.text: The explicit fact type exposed that each fixture document only has the fields relevant to its document type. I’m adjusting those fields to be optional in the shared shape and keeping the scenario mutations explicit with non-null assertions where the fixture guarantees the field.

Fixed the ESLint issues in [evaluation.ts](/mnt/d/Aristo/src/lib/evaluation.ts) with explicit `Citation` and `FactDocument` types, and removed the unused parameter from `unchanged`. The nine scenarios and their evaluation logic are unchanged.

Both `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` pass. No dependencies or unrelated files were changed.
